summary: This video breaks down key considerations when choosing what Mythic equipment to craft during the Piece of Treasury forging event. Players should weigh three main factors: which Temporal Vortex team is their primary damage dealer, which team performs best against the seasonal endgame boss, and upcoming meta shifts and gear availability in Season 9 based on Chinese test server data. For the creator's setup, Toxin heavily outperforms Dauntless on both Temporal Vortex and the endgame boss, leading him to forge a Converging Flames weapon (Raging Wildfire) tailored for Serpentemis. Looking ahead to Season 9, while Shadow and Toxin remain strong early on, Corrosion teams featuring Chorak are poised to dominate Temporal Vortex later in the season.

meta_changes: In Season 9, Corrosion becomes the dominant meta archetype for the AoE phase of Temporal Vortex, overtaking Toxin once high Inspiration levels and banners are unlocked.
Shadow and Corrosion banners are expected to arrive in the first two weeks of Season 9 based on Chinese server schedules.
Certain gear sets from Grave of Venom, Grave of Curse, and Grave of Rot carry over into Season 9 dungeon farming, while others (like Realm of Fallen Souls armor) will not be immediately available.
tips: Prioritize forging Mythic gear for the specific team that produces the most damage in Temporal Vortex and endgame bosses rather than spreading resources evenly.
Verify whether a gear set will remain farmable in the upcoming season before forging, as obsolete pieces can only be exchanged under specific conditions.
When crafting weapons like Raging Wildfire (Converging Flames), target Enlightenment secondary rolls alongside Attack% and Accuracy to maximize Enlightenment-scaling damage dealers.
HP% can be a stronger secondary roll than flat Attack on gear when paired with Dragonblood Brand, as it converts into bonus Attack.
